posts.name: everlastingtilt
posts.cooked:
Got it.  Not 100% sure on what triggered it exactly, but it sounds like what a lot of other people are reporting.  Here we go-

Argent Adept, Tempest, Greatest Legacy, Nightmist, DW Expat, in that order.

Realm of Discord (pretty sure that's a must), Time Flies, Portal Fiend.

Gloomweaver, 2 Chosen Disciples, 2 Cursed Acolytes, 1 Profane Zealot, the book and the drum, and the Indigo Pin, on NM.

NM had Master of Magic and her book out.  Might be worth noting that her deck was empty, 17 cards in the trash, the rest in hand.

Played Oblivion (3) to a 4/4 combo.  Told it to choose the damage order for me since there were so many targets.

I heard the theory about Mistfueled Recovery earlier, which I normally don't use (Tempest and Legs keep my health high enough I don't usually need it).  So I made sure to cast that a few times.  One round while Time Flies was out, I even used the Recovery followed immediately by Oblivion and that didn't work.

It might have been due to hitting a LOT of targets, or possibly from an insanely high damage total (I'm not even going to try to calculate all that).  I do know that in all my failures, I didn't use Mistfueled Recovery, so I'm leaning toward that theory.  Also, since the description in her bio mentions fighting off a large group of enemies before returning to Earth, that may also be part of it.  If the story has something to do with it, I did kill the Portal Fiend, which kinda matches.

My theory; use Mistbound Recovery at least once, cast Oblivion (maybe against a lot of targets), and kill a Portal Fiend.  Has anybody else noticed if environment targets are a common theme?  Not necessarily at the end, just at all.  Edit: oh yeah, and Expat.  duh.
